description: This file defines the UserService interface in Java, specifying methods for user-related operations such as finding users by email or supervisor, saving users, retrieving all users, and determining the maximum contract value a user can accept.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Java interface for user-related operations in the application.

methods.name: findByEmail
methods.description: Returns a User object with the specified email.

methods.name: saveUser
methods.description: Saves the given User object to the database.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all User objects.

methods.name: findBySupervisor
methods.description: Returns a list of Users supervised by the specified User.

methods.name: getMaxContractValue
methods.description: Returns the maximum contract value that the user can accept based on their roles.
